    return d
seq=[]
# safe moves in upper area (rows ~16-19), away from cart rows 32-39
moves=['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','RIGHT','RIGHT','RIGHT']
for m in moves:
    action([m], intent='explore')
    r=last_action_result
    if r.get('no_impact') or r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed'):
        print('stopped at', m, r.get('no_impact'), r.get('level_completed')); break
    seq.append((m, cart(current_frame)))
for s in seq: print(s)
print('final player', [n['boundary'][0] for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def cart(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('O','B'):
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            d[n['color']]=(min(rows),min(cols))
    return d
